QUOTE: Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` together. The macros must be set as a pair. When both are present, `platform.c` drops the runtime setter entirely, so calling it fails to link.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair set through the setter. It also says the macro configuration removes the runtime setter, so the two cannot be combined.
